notes.title: Fix and extra Mouse control!
notes.content:
Warriors have been given a slight magic defence boost. 

You can now control dual wield spells/melee with both left and right mouse buttons. Dual wielding 2 melee weapons in each hand is unaffected, holding left mouse button will automatically attack with whatever weapon is ready. Please go to "Options" and enable "Dual wield spells L/R mouse control" to use this new feature.

I have included a warning message on the launcher screen to windows 10 users, please ensure your display scaling settings on your desktop is set to 100% before playing the game. Right click desktop->display options. The game will be too large for the screen if it is not set at 100%. I'm trying to fix this but I don't have a working solution at the moment sorry.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25225537/76b5e5bb1d420d4c35f79bdd69279febdd20408f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Party EXP Fix and cave fix
notes.content:
Multiplayer EXP gains have been fixed (host was previously receiving twice as much EXP as clients)

EXP from summon-kills have also been fixed across multiplayer.

There was an inaccessible cave South-East of ryen-sek that has now been fixed. Previously you could not move after entering the cave and all you could do was go back out.

I am currently away for little while as I am moving business premises for my main job, please understand I will be working on the game when I can and I will be back in full force once this has stabilised. Thank you so much for your patience, help and bug reporting!
